declared: 2026-11-08, before the frozen rustc 1.98.0 oracle of these exact bytes and before any candidate run of these bytes. The shapes isolate batch 10's recorded `[const]` supertrait gap (docs/parallel/census-batch10.md, section 3; pa31/tests/spec/callable-sugar-coherence core-pattern, array-reference and slice-reference, where core's `const impl<A: Tuple, F: ?Sized> Fn<A> for &F where F: [const] Fn<A>` fails "trait implementation does not satisfy the trait's requirements"); batch 10's drafts repro/const-super-*.rs, with other bytes, were run with rustc 1.98.0 then. Each outcome follows the rule read in the pinned rustc 1.98.0 sources (compiler/rustc_hir_analysis/src/check/wfcheck.rs, which for a conditionally const impl registers each of the trait's const_conditions as a `[const]` (BoundConstness::Maybe) HostEffect goal; compiler/rustc_ty_utils/src/ty.rs `param_env`, which extends a conditionally const item's param-env with its own const_conditions as `[const]` assumptions; compiler/rustc_type_ir/src/elaborate.rs, which elaborates a `[const]` assumption to the trait's `[const]` supertraits; compiler/rustc_hir_analysis/src/hir_ty_lowering/mod.rs, which lowers a `const Tr` where clause to `Tr` plus a `const` HostEffect clause): a const impl's `[const]` supertrait holds through a const impl whose `[const]` premises follow from the impl's own `[const]` bounds, a plain supertrait needs only an ordinary impl, and a `[const]` supertrait fails through an ordinary impl, an ordinary premise or a `const` premise

shared-premise.rs.reason: batch 10's `const-super-struct`: `const trait Shared: [const] Once`, `const impl<F> Shared for W<F> where F: [const] Shared` and `const impl<F> Once for W<F> where F: [const] Shared`; the const condition `W<F>: [const] Once` holds through the const `Once` impl, whose `F: [const] Shared` is the impl's own assumption

once-premise.rs.reason: the same with `const impl<F> Once for W<F> where F: [const] Once`; the assumption `F: [const] Shared` elaborates to `F: [const] Once`

plain-supertrait.rs.reason: control: `const trait Shared: Once` with an ordinary `impl<F> Once for W<F>`; a plain supertrait is no const condition

ordinary-impls.rs.reason: control: ordinary impls of both const traits; an ordinary impl has no const conditions to check

ordinary-supertrait-impl.rs.reason: opponent: the const `Shared` impl beside an ordinary `impl<F> Once for W<F>`; the const condition `W<F>: [const] Once` needs a const impl or a `[const]` assumption

ordinary-premise.rs.reason: opponent: `const impl<F> Shared for W<F> where F: Shared` beside the const `Once` impl over `F: [const] Shared`; the ordinary premise gives no `[const]` assumption, so `F: [const] Shared` and with it `W<F>: [const] Once` fail

const-premise-required.rs.reason: opponent: the const `Shared` impl beside `const impl<F> Once for W<F> where F: const Shared`; the `[const]` assumption does not prove the `const` premise
